caption: Fig.2: Demonstration of the optimal tidy-up plan. The robot starts at the coffee table and 1) picks up the bottle, 2) navigates to a room with the side table and the recycle bin, 3) puts down the bottle, 4) grasps the soup can, 5) puts the soup can in the recycle bin, 6) re-grasps the bottle, 7) navigates to the kitchen, 8) places the bottle in the pantry.
